answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files a claim on a canyon ledger. A raven posts a bounty: prove a claim fake, collect 40 from its bond. Each epoch each identity files a tide proof; hunters replay it, and a copied proof or two claims on one stamp burns the bond and pays the hunter. The kth filing costs 42+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,038,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once, pays 42, keeps its bond.
